text:
maria: FYI - cluster-13 had 3 OOMs in 59m, all p95 batch workloads hitting long seqs. attaching quick flame graph + nvprof snapshot. root looks like kvcache growth + a kernel switch to a larger workspace.

david: any repro trace? which models?

maria: repro trace = user-chat-204 with an 8x burst, model=redwood-13x-8bit, seqs ~4096. nvprof shows workspace spike right before OOM; flame shows kvcache from ~1.2G -> 5.6G in ~150ms.

jess: that kv spike is classic KV-stacking from concurrent prefix caches. did runtime autotrim fire?

maria: autotrim triggered but too late. we had concurrent writes from streaming long-context requests. also kernel-selector picked fused-attn-kernel when seq > 2048 (bigger temp workspace).

nyla: immediate mitigations we can toggle live:
- request_shaper.max_tokens_per_batch = 2000
- kernel_selector.prefer_low_workspace = true
- kvcache.soft_eviction = true (ttl=30s)
- route fallback -> redwood-13x-8bit-compact for long-seq

david: can we push those without a full deploy? runtime-control API ok?

maria: yes. runtime-control supports dynamic flags. e.g.:
```
curl -X POST https://control.internal/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI" \
  -d '{"kernel_selector.prefer_low_workspace":"true","request_shaper.max_tokens_per_batch":"2000"}'
```

sre-bot: Alert: circuit breaker trip threshold reached on cluster-13 (3 OOMs). auto-scale blocked for dedicated pool.

jess: also recommend temporarily setting buffer_reuse=aggressive and enabling a compact-kernel fallback chain: when mem > 75% force kernel downgrade. allow a small latency budget bump for those routes.

maria: +1. short-term policy: reject single requests with seq > 8192 returning 413 + chunking hint.

nyla: i'll own the runtime flags. plan (ETA 10m):
- push kernel_selector.prefer_low_workspace = true
- enable kvcache.soft_eviction = on
- add route policy: if seq > 4096 route -> compact model

david: i'll add a console panel for token-level memory and a live kvcache growth graph (grafana).

jess: postmortem items: increase autotrim aggressiveness, add predictive pre-trim heuristics tied to concurrency, and add unit/regression test for kernel-selector under long-context bursts.

maria: after flags are live we'll monitor for 30m. if OOMs persist: fallback to redwood-7b-quant for that route and open an incident channel.

deploy-bot: Canary config push started to 3 hosts in cluster-13.

maria: canary finished, flags are live. initial telemetry: p99 mem margin improved from ~8% -> ~24%. no OOMs for 12m so far.

nyla: closing loop: filing ticket for hooking kv eviction into request lifetime (owner: nyla, ticket #1234).

jess: ack. nice triage everyone. :thumbsup:
